Lymphoedema presentation at KSRM 2026

Dr Jeremy Sun presented at the 45th Congress of the Korean Society for Reconstructive Microsurgery (KSRM 2026), held at Sejong University Convention Center in Seoul on 23–24 October 2026. His talk, Evolution in Lymphedema Management: An Algorithmic Approach from Mild to Advanced Disease, was listed in the Lymphatics 1 (Advanced Lymphedema) session on 24 October. See the official scientific programme and invited-speaker listing. This records a professional education contribution, not organiser endorsement of clinical services.
